test_title: PYST 36: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 26 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.

He was (a) bad injured (b) in the (c) last match.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect usage of the word "**bad**" instead of "**badly**."
 
• The adverb "badly" should be used to modify the verb "injured".
 
• The correct phrase should be "**badly injured**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He was **badly injured** in the last match."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "last match" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "in the"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "He was"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
